One to four questions with tappable options, a default, and a timeout.

**Direction:** Harness → Chips  
**Sent by:** a harness  
**Requires a run:** yes  
**Schema:** [`question.ask.json`](/schema/question.ask.json)

| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
